title: Ghana Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Historical flood impacts; modelled poverty impacts to 2050
methodology: World Bank CCDR with climate-risk, economic, and poverty analysis.
limitations: The cited poverty effects are modelled; the coastal and annual flood figures are national-level estimates.

title: Climate-Proofing Northern Ghana’s Future: Investing in Resilient Livelihoods and Infrastructure
organization: National Development Planning Commission (Ghana), prepared for the SOCO project
geographic_coverage: 48 districts across five northern regions and Oti Region
temporal_coverage: Historical droughts 1981–2019; 2024 drought and flood reporting; projection to 2080
methodology: Policy brief reports a mixed-method study with geospatial analysis and interviews involving 210 participants.
limitations: Reported district and event findings are not a national causal estimate; the cited 2080 risk passage does not identify its projection scenario.

title: Ghana’s Updated Nationally Determined Contribution under the Paris Agreement (2020–2030)
methodology: Government NDC setting out mitigation and adaptation actions, institutional responsibilities, and intended coverage.
limitations: The beneficiary figure is a planned reach, not an independently verified result.
